description.value: Gelato Express is a gelato shop on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, specializing in authentic Italian-style gelato with flavors ranging from passion fruit and blood orange to tiramisu and Ferrero Rocher. The shop features both indoor and outdoor seating in a cozy, modern space decorated with artwork and Minions paraphernalia. It's a convenient sweet-stop for cyclists riding through downtown Vancouver.
